sampling_unit: multistage: geographic PSU, then school (PPS by senior-class size), then students/classrooms within school
assignment_unit: survey year (cohort) is observational, not assigned; forms are distributed within school in ordered/random sequence
clusters: schools within PSUs; no school or PSU identifiers in the public files; article uses no clustering
native_se_method_software: LISREL 8.7 (Joreskog & Sorbom, 2004) model-based ML standard errors for latent means; conventional t tests for items (software for t tests not stated)

vintage_notes: Article (2010) cites Johnston, Bachman & O'Malley (2006) 2nd ICPSR edition as the data source and states 2006 was the most recent year available at analysis time; the packet supplies 1976 V4 (2007-05-25), 1991 V1 (2006-03-30) and 2006 V3 (2008-09-12). ICPSR changed missing-value assignment for one 1976 variable (V151, not used here) in 2007 and removed 14 Form 3 variables (V3319-V3332, not used) in 2004. Year codes in V1 and missing codes differ by release; none of the work items in the 2006 files are among the Western-region suppressed variables (checked in dictionaries: suppressed items are V4169, V4170, V4264-V4266 in Form 4 and V3169, V3170 in Form 3).
